dp_public_preprocessing.source: MNIST public pixel range [0,1], uint8 / 255; no fitted moments

protocol.randomness_note: Benchmark seed controls algorithms, partitions and availability. DP noise uses OS-backed randomness and is intentionally not seeded.

execution_resources.timings_note: Runs execute concurrently on disjoint two-CPU affinity sets; shared memory and host resources can still affect wall time.
execution_resources.flower_state: New server, model parameters, Context and ClientApp each simulation; client_fn creates a NumPyClient for each message. Stateless actor processes reused; no pending tasks at run boundaries.
execution_resources.flower_timing_note: Ray and actor infrastructure initialization recorded separately; runtime_sec measures simulation using initialized workers.
execution_resources.client_factory_transport: Ray object store once per simulation; ObjectRef resolved in each actor call

history_note: Exact original adapter history; empty history means no trace was recorded. Global ARI/AMI/NMI were measured at the end, not after every round.
timestamps_note: Exact UTC timestamps recorded by each worker. Comparison dates span grouped workers; individual measured algorithm times are preserved.
